verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports confirm Ollama ships its own desktop app for macOS and Windows that works as a chat GUI, with multimodal and Markdown rendering, so the product itself provides the capability. Limits are reported too: no Linux version and no way to connect to a remote Ollama instance, and the evidence pack has no first-party documentation of the chat interface. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the GUI chat app, Linux support, remote-instance connection, and detail on chat features such as history and model switching in the GUI.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface

citations.quote: Ollama's new app is now available for macOS and Windows
Multimodal and Markdown support works as expected.
this app doesn't seem to offer any way to connect to a remote Ollama instance
